answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the atlas until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the dawn of the next round. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the kernel is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
